title: The Lord Reigns, Let the Earth Rejoice

questions.question: The Lord reigns, let the earth rejoice; let the many coastlands be what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 97:1 (ESV): "The Lord reigns, let the earth rejoice; let the many coastlands be glad!"

questions.question: Clouds and thick darkness are all around him; righteousness and justice are the foundation of his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 97:2 (ESV): "...righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne."

questions.question: Fire goes before him and burns up his adversaries all what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 97:3 (ESV): "Fire goes before him and burns up his adversaries all around."

questions.question: His lightnings light up the world; the earth sees and does what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 97:4 (ESV): "His lightnings light up the world; the earth sees and trembles."

questions.question: The mountains melt like wax before the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 97:5 (ESV): "The mountains melt like wax before the Lord,"

questions.question: The heavens proclaim his righteousness, and all the peoples see his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 97:6 (ESV): "The heavens proclaim his righteousness, and all the peoples see his glory."

questions.question: All worshipers of images are put to shame, who make their boast in worthless what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 97:7 (ESV): "...who make their boast in worthless idols;"

questions.question: For you, O Lord, are most high over all the earth; you are exalted far above all what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 97:9 (ESV): "...you are exalted far above all gods."

questions.question: O you who love the Lord, hate what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 97:10 (ESV): "O you who love the Lord, hate evil!"

questions.question: He preserves the lives of his saints; he delivers them from the hand of the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 97:10 (ESV): "...he delivers them from the hand of the wicked."

questions.question: Light is sown for the righteous, and joy for the upright in what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 97:11 (ESV): "Light is sown for the righteous, and joy for the upright in heart."

questions.question: Rejoice in the Lord, O you righteous, and give thanks to his holy what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 97:12 (ESV): "Rejoice in the Lord, O you righteous, and give thanks to his holy name!"

questions.question: Zion hears and is glad, and the daughters of Judah rejoice, because of your what, O Lord?
questions.explanation: Psalm 97:8 (ESV): "...because of your judgments, O Lord."

questions.question: Before the Lord of all the earth, the mountains melt like what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 97:5 (ESV): "The mountains melt like wax before the Lord,"

key_verse_text: O you who love the Lord, hate evil! He preserves the lives of his saints; he delivers them from the hand of the wicked.
